0022600136.text: The Raptors (2-1, second in the Atlantic and 0.5 games back) host the 1-2 Orlando Magic, who are fourth in the Southeast, one game back, and coming off a win. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Kawhi Leonard is day-to-day with knee inflammation and a game-time decision, while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), with Jalen Suggs day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and beat Orlando 139-87 in Toronto on March 29, and the two teams have not met yet in 2026-27.
